verdict.rationale: Brex markets 'AI-powered automation' for invoice entry and GL coding (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-9), suggesting some AI delegation capability, but this falls short of a true conversational AI assistant users can delegate arbitrary tasks to. Community evidence directly disputes reliability of Brex's AI/chatbot efforts—citing hallucination risks, sloppy engineering, incorrect outputs, and skepticism that it was more of a 'recruiting exercise' than production feature, with one comment explicitly noting Brex failed to make the AI pivot unlike competitor Ramp.
